examples.message:
Hi Tom, great to connect.

We're hosting a series of curated, invite-only summits this spring to help health system technology leaders accelerate vendor decision-making across autonomous coding, AI CDI, and AI denials management.

I wanted to extend an invite in case you're evaluating solutions in any of these areas this year.
